snippet.title: Star Wars Battlefront II: Obi-Wan Kenobi and Geonosis – Community Update
snippet.description:
Update: The new Shattered Armor appearance shown in this is a work in progress version. It is Legendary in-game, not Epic.

Fight as the cherished Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi on Geonosis in the latest Star Wars™ Battlefront™ II update, available now! Control the beastly AT-TE walker on the rugged wastelands, battle as the 212th Attack Battalion, and roam the fields with the STAP and the BARC speeder.

Full details on the Battle of Geonosis Update: https://www.ea.com/games/starwars/battlefront/battlefront-2/news/battle-of-geonosis-update-is-coming-november-28.
